# Llaminar V2 Test Suite
# Canonical registration for Unit, integration, production parity, E2E and
# performance. Build gates derive dependencies from these same registrations,
# including executables passed as arguments to script-based test drivers.

# Note: enable_testing() is called in parent CMakeLists.txt (src/v2/CMakeLists.txt)

# The profiling annotations belong only to test/tuning executables. Use the
# package's imported target so missing headers/libraries fail during configure,
# rather than handing Ninja an unchecked SDK filename. A serving-only Release
# build does not enter this directory and has no annotation dependency.
if(HAVE_ROCM)
    find_package(rocprofiler-sdk-roctx CONFIG REQUIRED)
endif()

# =============================================================================
# Linker Workaround for Circular Static Library Dependencies
# =============================================================================
# llaminar2_core links cuda_backend, but cuda_backend uses symbols from llaminar2_core.
# On GNU ld, we need --start-group / --end-group to resolve circular dependencies.
# This function wraps target_link_libraries to add the needed linker flags.
function(target_link_libraries_with_groups target)
    if(UNIX AND NOT APPLE)
        # Add start-group before libraries and end-group after
        target_link_libraries(${target} PRIVATE 
            -Wl,--start-group
            ${ARGN}
            -Wl,--end-group
        )
    else()
        # On macOS/others, just link normally
        target_link_libraries(${target} PRIVATE ${ARGN})
    endif()
endfunction()

# Build GPU tests as one binary per backend. CUDA and HIP device runtimes can
# register linked device code before main(), so combined CUDA+ROCm test binaries
# can fail before gtest skip guards run. Split binaries preserve backend coverage
# while keeping startup deterministic.
function(add_v2_gpu_backend_test TARGET_BASE SOURCE TEST_BASE)
    set(TEST_LABELS ${ARGN})

    if(HAVE_ROCM)
        set(ROCM_TARGET ${TARGET_BASE}_rocm)
        add_executable(${ROCM_TARGET} ${SOURCE})
        target_compile_definitions(${ROCM_TARGET} PRIVATE GPU_CONTEXT_TEST_BACKEND_ROCM=1)
        if(LLAMINAR_SHARED_CORE)
            target_link_libraries(${ROCM_TARGET} PRIVATE
                llaminar2_core
                GTest::gtest
                GTest::gtest_main
            )
        else()
            target_link_libraries(${ROCM_TARGET} PRIVATE
                -Wl,--start-group
                llaminar2_core
                -Wl,--whole-archive rocm_backend -Wl,--no-whole-archive
                -Wl,--end-group
                GTest::gtest
                GTest::gtest_main
            )
        endif()
        add_v2_test(${TEST_BASE}_ROCm
            COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:${ROCM_TARGET}>
            LABELS ${TEST_LABELS} ROCm
            MPI_PROCS 1
            NO_MODELS
        )
    endif()

    if(HAVE_CUDA)
        set(CUDA_TARGET ${TARGET_BASE}_cuda)
        add_executable(${CUDA_TARGET} ${SOURCE})
        target_compile_definitions(${CUDA_TARGET} PRIVATE GPU_CONTEXT_TEST_BACKEND_CUDA=1)
        if(LLAMINAR_SHARED_CORE)
            target_link_libraries(${CUDA_TARGET} PRIVATE
                llaminar2_core
                GTest::gtest
                GTest::gtest_main
            )
        else()
            target_link_libraries(${CUDA_TARGET} PRIVATE
                -Wl,--start-group
                llaminar2_core
                -Wl,--whole-archive cuda_backend -Wl,--no-whole-archive
                -Wl,--end-group
                GTest::gtest
                GTest::gtest_main
            )
        endif()
        add_v2_test(${TEST_BASE}_CUDA
            COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:${CUDA_TARGET}>
            LABELS ${TEST_LABELS} CUDA
            MPI_PROCS 1
            NO_MODELS
        )
    endif()

    if(NOT HAVE_ROCM AND NOT HAVE_CUDA)
        set(CPU_ONLY_TARGET ${TARGET_BASE})
        add_executable(${CPU_ONLY_TARGET} ${SOURCE})
        target_link_libraries(${CPU_ONLY_TARGET} PRIVATE
            llaminar2_core
            GTest::gtest
            GTest::gtest_main
        )
        add_v2_test(${TEST_BASE}
            COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:${CPU_ONLY_TARGET}>
            LABELS ${TEST_LABELS}
            MPI_PROCS 1
            NO_MODELS
        )
    endif()
endfunction()

# =============================================================================
# CPU Topology Detection for Test Configuration
# =============================================================================
# Detect system topology to configure optimal MPI/OpenMP settings for tests
execute_process(
    COMMAND bash -c "lscpu | grep 'Socket(s):' | awk '{print $2}'"
    OUTPUT_VARIABLE V2_TEST_SOCKETS
    OUTPUT_STRIP_TRAILING_WHITESPACE
)
execute_process(
    COMMAND bash -c "lscpu | grep 'Core(s) per socket:' | awk '{print $4}'"
    OUTPUT_VARIABLE V2_TEST_CORES_PER_SOCKET
    OUTPUT_STRIP_TRAILING_WHITESPACE
)
execute_process(
    COMMAND bash -c "lscpu | grep 'Thread(s) per core:' | awk '{print $4}'"
    OUTPUT_VARIABLE V2_TEST_THREADS_PER_CORE
    OUTPUT_STRIP_TRAILING_WHITESPACE
)

if(NOT V2_TEST_SOCKETS OR V2_TEST_SOCKETS EQUAL "")
    set(V2_TEST_SOCKETS 1)
endif()
if(NOT V2_TEST_CORES_PER_SOCKET OR V2_TEST_CORES_PER_SOCKET EQUAL "")
    set(V2_TEST_CORES_PER_SOCKET 1)
endif()
if(NOT V2_TEST_THREADS_PER_CORE OR V2_TEST_THREADS_PER_CORE EQUAL "")
    set(V2_TEST_THREADS_PER_CORE 1)
endif()

# Always use at least 2 MPI ranks for testing (even on single-socket systems)
if(V2_TEST_SOCKETS LESS 2)
    set(V2_TEST_MIN_RANKS 2)
    set(V2_TEST_NEEDS_OVERSUBSCRIBE TRUE)
    message(STATUS "V2 Test Configuration: ${V2_TEST_SOCKETS} socket(s), ${V2_TEST_CORES_PER_SOCKET} cores/socket, ${V2_TEST_THREADS_PER_CORE} threads/core")
    message(STATUS "V2 Tests will use: mpirun -np 2 --oversubscribe with OMP_NUM_THREADS=${V2_TEST_CORES_PER_SOCKET}")
else()
    set(V2_TEST_MIN_RANKS ${V2_TEST_SOCKETS})
    set(V2_TEST_NEEDS_OVERSUBSCRIBE FALSE)
    message(STATUS "V2 Test Configuration: ${V2_TEST_SOCKETS} sockets, ${V2_TEST_CORES_PER_SOCKET} cores/socket, ${V2_TEST_THREADS_PER_CORE} threads/core")
    message(STATUS "V2 Tests will use: mpirun -np ${V2_TEST_SOCKETS} with OMP_NUM_THREADS=${V2_TEST_CORES_PER_SOCKET}")
endif()

# =============================================================================
# Release-mode guard: only build performance test targets
# =============================================================================
# When V2_PERF_TESTS_ONLY is ON (set by parent for Release builds), we override
# add_executable so that only targets with the v2_perf_ prefix are created.
# All other test executables (v2_test_*, v2_integration_*, v2_unit_*,
# v2_orchestration_*, v2_e2e_*) become no-ops, keeping the Release build lean.
# The add_v2_test() and discover_v2_parity_tests() functions also early-return
# for non-perf tests when this flag is set.
include(${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/cmake/V2TestTargetSelection.cmake)

# =============================================================================
# All V2 tests require GGUF models to be present. This fixture ensures
# the fetch_test_models.sh script runs before any test suite executes.

# Path to the model fetching script (relative to this CMakeLists.txt)
set(FETCH_MODELS_SCRIPT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../scripts/fetch_test_models.sh")
set(PROJECT_ROOT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../..")

# This test will always pass (exit 0) but ensures models are downloaded
add_test(
    NAME V2_FetchModelsFixture
    COMMAND bash -c "bash ${FETCH_MODELS_SCRIPT} || exit 0"
    WORKING_DIRECTORY ${PROJECT_ROOT}
)

set_tests_properties(V2_FetchModelsFixture PROPERTIES
    FIXTURES_SETUP V2_Models           # This test provides the V2_Models fixture
    TIMEOUT 600                         # 10 minute timeout for large downloads
    LABELS "V2;Fixture;Models"
)

# =============================================================================
# Helper Function: Add V2 Test with Model Dependency and MPI
# =============================================================================
# Usage: add_v2_test(TestName COMMAND executable [args...] LABELS label1 label2
#                     [MPI_PROCS n] [NO_MPI] [NO_MODELS] [ENVIRONMENT NAME=value ...]
#                     [REQUIRED_FILES path ...]
#                     [SKIP_REGULAR_EXPRESSION regex])
# This automatically:
#   - Wraps the test with mpirun and optimal MPI/OpenMP settings
#   - Makes the test depend on the V2_Models fixture unless NO_MODELS is explicit
#   - Sets environment variables for optimal performance

function(add_v2_test TEST_NAME)
    # In Release mode (V2_PERF_TESTS_ONLY), skip non-performance tests
    if(V2_PERF_TESTS_ONLY AND NOT "${TEST_NAME}" MATCHES "^V2_Perf_")
        return()
    endif()

    cmake_parse_arguments(
        ARG                             # Prefix for parsed args
        "NO_MODELS;NO_MPI"              # Explicit model/process requirements
        "MPI_PROCS;TIMEOUT;SKIP_REGULAR_EXPRESSION" # One-value keywords
        "COMMAND;LABELS;RESOURCE_LOCK;ENVIRONMENT;REQUIRED_FILES"  # Multi-value keywords
        ${ARGN}                         # Arguments to parse
    )

    # Retain target identities before MPI wrapping or Debug path rewriting.
    # Script drivers may receive their tested executable in a later argument,
    # so inspecting only COMMAND[0] would leave clean-build gates incomplete.
    set(V2_TEST_BUILD_TARGETS "")
    foreach(V2_TEST_COMMAND_ARG IN LISTS ARG_COMMAND)
        if(V2_TEST_COMMAND_ARG MATCHES "\\$<TARGET_FILE:([^>]+)>")
            list(APPEND V2_TEST_BUILD_TARGETS "${CMAKE_MATCH_1}")
        elseif(TARGET "${V2_TEST_COMMAND_ARG}")
            list(APPEND V2_TEST_BUILD_TARGETS "${V2_TEST_COMMAND_ARG}")
        endif()
    endforeach()
    list(REMOVE_DUPLICATES V2_TEST_BUILD_TARGETS)
    # A backend-specific GTest filter does not narrow process startup. Targets
    # that discover the full machine may initialize the other vendor merely to
    # query its free memory. Carry that ownership into every registration of
    # the executable so split CUDA/ROCm preflight lanes cannot overlap it with
    # a graph-memory certificate on the supposedly unselected backend.
    foreach(V2_TEST_BUILD_TARGET IN LISTS V2_TEST_BUILD_TARGETS)
        # A few legacy registrations forward-reference an ordinary executable.
        # Explicit startup scopes must be declared before their registrations;
        # retain forward references for the default declared-backend scope.
        if(NOT TARGET ${V2_TEST_BUILD_TARGET})
            continue()
        endif()
        get_target_property(V2_TEST_DEVICE_SCOPE
            ${V2_TEST_BUILD_TARGET} V2_TEST_DEVICE_SCOPE)
        if(V2_TEST_DEVICE_SCOPE STREQUAL "FullInventory")
            if("Unit" IN_LIST ARG_LABELS)
                message(FATAL_ERROR
                    "Device-free Unit target declares full GPU inventory: ${TEST_NAME}")
            elseif("DeviceFree" IN_LIST ARG_LABELS)
                message(FATAL_ERROR
                    "Device-free integration target declares full GPU inventory: ${TEST_NAME}")
            endif()
            list(APPEND ARG_LABELS "FullDeviceInventory")
        elseif(V2_TEST_DEVICE_SCOPE AND
               NOT V2_TEST_DEVICE_SCOPE STREQUAL "DeclaredBackends")
            message(FATAL_ERROR
                "Unknown device scope '${V2_TEST_DEVICE_SCOPE}' for ${V2_TEST_BUILD_TARGET}")
        endif()
    endforeach()
    list(REMOVE_DUPLICATES ARG_LABELS)
    set_property(GLOBAL PROPERTY
        "V2_TEST_BUILD_TARGETS_${TEST_NAME}" "${V2_TEST_BUILD_TARGETS}")

    # Unit is an architectural boundary, not merely a display label. Both
    # script and binary registrations contribute their declared dependencies.
    if("${TEST_NAME}" MATCHES "^V2_Unit_")
        if(NOT "${ARG_LABELS}" MATCHES "Unit")
            message(FATAL_ERROR
                "Unit test is missing the Unit label: ${TEST_NAME}")
        endif()
        if(V2_TEST_BUILD_TARGETS)
            set_property(GLOBAL APPEND PROPERTY
                V2_UNIT_GATE_TARGETS ${V2_TEST_BUILD_TARGETS})
        endif()
    endif()
    
    # Default process count: one for Unit, topology-sized elsewhere.
    if(NOT DEFINED ARG_MPI_PROCS)
        # Unit tests are device-free, isolated processes unless their
        # registration explicitly declares a multi-rank protocol topology.
        # Duplicating every ordinary GTest body once per socket is neither
        # coverage nor useful work and makes the canonical unit gate opaque.
        if("${ARG_LABELS}" MATCHES "Unit")
            set(ARG_MPI_PROCS 1)
        elseif(V2_TEST_SOCKETS LESS 2)
            set(ARG_MPI_PROCS 2)
        else()
            set(ARG_MPI_PROCS ${V2_TEST_SOCKETS})
        endif()
    endif()

    # Independent one-rank unit jobs cannot all be pinned to socket zero: each
    # mpirun instance would choose the same socket and defeat CTest's otherwise
    # correct node-wide CPU accounting. Leave only that case to the Linux
    # scheduler. Multi-rank topology tests retain socket mapping, as do all
    # integration and performance processes.
    set(TEST_MPI_PLACEMENT --bind-to socket --map-by socket)
    if("${ARG_LABELS}" MATCHES "Unit" AND ARG_MPI_PROCS EQUAL 1)
        set(TEST_MPI_PLACEMENT --bind-to none --map-by slot)
    endif()

    # Build mpirun command with optimal settings
    set(MPI_CMD
        mpirun
        -np ${ARG_MPI_PROCS}
        ${TEST_MPI_PLACEMENT}
        --mca mpi_leave_pinned 1
        --mca btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism none
        --mca orte_allowed_exit_without_sync 1
    )

    # Open MPI may remove the shared /tmp/ompi.<host>.<uid> parent as one
    # independent launcher exits while another is creating its session. The
    # Unit gate starts hundreds of one-rank launchers concurrently, so give
    # each registered test an exclusive session root. Keep it in the build
    # tree: the installed test-runner image retains that tree and owns it as
    # the test UID, while local and node-local MPI ranks see the same path.
    if(NOT ARG_NO_MPI)
        set(TEST_MPI_SESSION_BASE
            "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/mpi-sessions/${TEST_NAME}")
        file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${TEST_MPI_SESSION_BASE}")
        list(APPEND MPI_CMD --mca orte_tmpdir_base "${TEST_MPI_SESSION_BASE}")
    endif()
    
    # Add --oversubscribe if we have fewer sockets than MPI ranks
    if(V2_TEST_SOCKETS LESS ARG_MPI_PROCS)
        list(APPEND MPI_CMD --oversubscribe)
    endif()
    
    # Integration tests use build_v2_integration (Release + snapshots + debug symbols).
    # Every other test uses the current build. Server E2E tests are registered
    # only by Release configurations below, so they exercise deployable code.
    set(USE_INTEGRATION_BUILD FALSE)
    if(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE MATCHES "Debug")
        if("${ARG_LABELS}" MATCHES "Integration")
            set(USE_INTEGRATION_BUILD TRUE)
        endif()
    endif()
    
    # Determine executable path based on test type
    if(USE_INTEGRATION_BUILD)
        # Use Integration build (build_v2_integration)
        set(INTEGRATION_BUILD_DIR "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/../../build_v2_integration")
        list(GET ARG_COMMAND 0 EXECUTABLE_TARGET)
        get_filename_component(EXECUTABLE_NAME ${EXECUTABLE_TARGET} NAME)

        # Absolute tools such as the discovered Python interpreter are already
        # complete commands. Rewriting them beneath tests/v2 produces an invalid
        # path and silently breaks every script registered through this helper.
        if(IS_ABSOLUTE "${EXECUTABLE_TARGET}")
            set(FINAL_COMMAND ${ARG_COMMAND})
        elseif(EXECUTABLE_TARGET MATCHES "\\$<TARGET_FILE:")
            string(REGEX REPLACE ".*TARGET_FILE:([^>]+)>.*" "\\1" TARGET_NAME "${EXECUTABLE_TARGET}")
            set(EXECUTABLE_PATH "${INTEGRATION_BUILD_DIR}/tests/v2/${TARGET_NAME}")
            list(REMOVE_AT ARG_COMMAND 0)
            set(FINAL_COMMAND ${EXECUTABLE_PATH} ${ARG_COMMAND})
        else()
            set(EXECUTABLE_PATH "${INTEGRATION_BUILD_DIR}/tests/v2/${EXECUTABLE_NAME}")
            list(REMOVE_AT ARG_COMMAND 0)
            set(FINAL_COMMAND ${EXECUTABLE_PATH} ${ARG_COMMAND})
        endif()
    else()
        # Use Debug build (default, CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR)
        # Check if COMMAND uses $<TARGET_FILE:...> generator expression
        list(GET ARG_COMMAND 0 FIRST_ARG)
        if(IS_ABSOLUTE "${FIRST_ARG}" OR FIRST_ARG MATCHES "\\$<TARGET_FILE:")
            # Absolute tools and generator expressions already carry full paths.
            set(FINAL_COMMAND ${ARG_COMMAND})
        else()
            # Bare executable name, need to prepend CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR
            set(EXECUTABLE_PATH "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/${FIRST_ARG}")
            list(REMOVE_AT ARG_COMMAND 0)
            set(FINAL_COMMAND ${EXECUTABLE_PATH} ${ARG_COMMAND})
        endif()
    endif()
    
    # Plain host tests still use the canonical registration/build authority,
    # without bootstrapping MPI when their interface has no MPI dependency.
    if(ARG_NO_MPI)
        if(NOT ARG_MPI_PROCS EQUAL 1)
            message(FATAL_ERROR "NO_MPI test declares multiple ranks: ${TEST_NAME}")
        endif()
        set(MPI_CMD "")
    endif()
    add_test(NAME ${TEST_NAME} COMMAND ${MPI_CMD} ${FINAL_COMMAND})
    
    # Determine default log level based on test type (Unit/Integration = DEBUG, Performance = INFO)
    set(DEFAULT_LOG_LEVEL "DEBUG")
    if("${ARG_LABELS}" MATCHES "Performance")
        set(DEFAULT_LOG_LEVEL "INFO")
    endif()
    
    # Production and integration work deliberately use every physical core in
    # the rank's socket. Unit tests instead share the host under unrestricted
    # CTest parallelism, so their implicit OpenMP width must agree with the CPU
    # slots advertised to CTest. Keep four slots as the ordinary unit budget,
    # divide those slots across MPI ranks, and grow the budget for tests that
    # intentionally exercise more than four ranks. Focused thread-totality
    # tests choose their own explicit widths; a unit test must never inherit a
    # hidden 28-thread team merely because this host has 28 cores per socket.
    set(TEST_OMP_THREADS ${V2_TEST_CORES_PER_SOCKET})
    set(TEST_OMP_PLACES sockets)
    set(TEST_OMP_PROC_BIND close)
    set(TEST_KMP_AFFINITY "granularity=fine,compact,1,0")
    set(TEST_PROCESSORS 4)
    if("${ARG_LABELS}" MATCHES "Unit")
        if(ARG_MPI_PROCS GREATER TEST_PROCESSORS)
            set(TEST_PROCESSORS ${ARG_MPI_PROCS})
        endif()
        math(EXPR TEST_OMP_THREADS
             "${TEST_PROCESSORS} / ${ARG_MPI_PROCS}")
        if(TEST_OMP_THREADS LESS 1)
            set(TEST_OMP_THREADS 1)
        endif()
        set(TEST_OMP_PLACES cores)
        set(TEST_OMP_PROC_BIND false)
        set(TEST_KMP_AFFINITY disabled)
    endif()

    # Build base environment variables for optimal performance + logging.
    set(TEST_ENV 
        "LLAMINAR_LOG_LEVEL=${DEFAULT_LOG_LEVEL}"
        "LLAMINAR_TP_COLLECT_TIMEOUT_MS=30000"
        "HWLOC_COMPONENTS=-gl,-opencl"
        "OMP_NUM_THREADS=${TEST_OMP_THREADS}"
        "OMP_PLACES=${TEST_OMP_PLACES}"
        "OMP_PROC_BIND=${TEST_OMP_PROC_BIND}"
        "OMP_NESTED=false"
        "OMP_DYNAMIC=false"
        "KMP_AFFINITY=${TEST_KMP_AFFINITY}"
        "KMP_BLOCKTIME=0"
        "MKL_NUM_THREADS=${TEST_OMP_THREADS}"
        "MKL_DYNAMIC=false"
        "OMPI_MCA_mpi_leave_pinned=1"
        "OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism=none"
        "OMPI_MCA_btl_openib_allow_ib=1"
    )

    # Unit tests exercise host-side policy, state machines, and pure kernels.
    # Physical GPU discovery or context creation belongs in Integration tests:
    # it makes unit results depend on driver state, consumes shared devices,
    # and can destabilize otherwise independent processes under a parallel
    # CTest gate. Enforce the same boundary for explicitly device-free focused
    # preflight registrations of these fixtures, not just their Unit entry.
    if("Unit" IN_LIST ARG_LABELS OR "DeviceFree" IN_LIST ARG_LABELS)
        list(APPEND TEST_ENV "LLAMINAR_FORCE_CPU_ONLY_STARTUP=1")
        foreach(TEST_LOCAL_ENV IN LISTS ARG_ENVIRONMENT)
            if(TEST_LOCAL_ENV MATCHES "^LLAMINAR_FORCE_CPU_ONLY_STARTUP=(.*)$" AND
               NOT CMAKE_MATCH_1 STREQUAL "1")
                message(FATAL_ERROR
                    "Device-free test overrides CPU-only startup: ${TEST_NAME}")
            endif()
        endforeach()
    endif()
    
    # Add ROCm environment variables for ROCm tests
    # HSA_OVERRIDE_GFX_VERSION=9.0.6 enables gfx906 (MI50/MI60) codepaths on compatible GPUs
    if("${ARG_LABELS}" MATCHES "ROCm")
        list(APPEND TEST_ENV "HSA_OVERRIDE_GFX_VERSION=9.0.6")
    endif()

    # Keep test-local environment attached to the registration operation. A
    # caller-side set_property(TEST ...) is invalid when Release deliberately
    # omits a non-performance test, whereas this helper returns before either
    # the test or its environment is created.
    if(ARG_ENVIRONMENT)
        list(APPEND TEST_ENV ${ARG_ENVIRONMENT})
    endif()
    
    # Set environment variables
    # Working directory: project root (so model paths like "models/..." work)
    # CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR is /workspaces/llaminar/src/v2, so go up two levels to reach project root
    set_tests_properties(${TEST_NAME} PROPERTIES
        LABELS "${ARG_LABELS}"
        ENVIRONMENT "${TEST_ENV}"
        WORKING_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/../.."
    )
    # GTest returns success when a stale filter selects no tests. A renamed
    # floating-expert regression exposed this false-green gate, so reject the
    # empty-run summary centrally (including --gtest_brief and MPI output).
    set_property(TEST ${TEST_NAME} APPEND PROPERTY FAIL_REGULAR_EXPRESSION
        "0 tests? from 0 test suites?")
    # Optional hardware is a property of the registered test. Keeping the
    # property in this helper prevents Release's omitted tests from acquiring
    # dangling caller-side metadata; it never converts executed failures to a pass.
    if(DEFINED ARG_SKIP_REGULAR_EXPRESSION AND NOT ARG_SKIP_REGULAR_EXPRESSION STREQUAL "")
        set_tests_properties(${TEST_NAME} PROPERTIES
            SKIP_REGULAR_EXPRESSION "${ARG_SKIP_REGULAR_EXPRESSION}")
    endif()
    # Required source files belong to the same registration as the test.
    # Release omits non-performance tests before either owner is materialized.
    if(ARG_REQUIRED_FILES)
        set_tests_properties(${TEST_NAME} PROPERTIES
            REQUIRED_FILES "${ARG_REQUIRED_FILES}")
    endif()
    # Unit tests are necessarily model-free.  Requiring every registration to
    # repeat NO_MODELS allowed hundreds of fast tests to inherit the download
    # fixture accidentally, so encode the invariant at the helper boundary.
    if(NOT ARG_NO_MODELS AND NOT "${ARG_LABELS}" MATCHES "Unit")
        set_tests_properties(${TEST_NAME} PROPERTIES
            FIXTURES_REQUIRED V2_Models)
    endif()
    
    # =========================================================================
    # PROCESSORS: Tell CTest how many CPU slots each test consumes.
    #
    # CTest uses PROCESSORS to cap concurrent tests so the total does not
    # exceed the --parallel limit (defaults to nproc = 112 on 2×28c HT).
    # Unit slots and their MPI/OpenMP widths are derived together above. This
    # is the accounting authority that permits the documented unrestricted
    # gate without starving unrelated tests. Non-unit work retains four CTest
    # slots here because Integration is serialized separately and performance
    # tests are selected deliberately.
    # =========================================================================
    set_tests_properties(${TEST_NAME} PROPERTIES
        PROCESSORS ${TEST_PROCESSORS}
    )

    # Add RESOURCE_LOCK if specified (prevents parallel execution of tests needing same resource)
    # All integration tests share a single lock to force serial execution even
    # under `ctest --parallel`.  Parity tests have their own lock
    # ("Parity_Model_Execution") set by discover_v2_parity_tests(), so they are
    # unaffected here.
    if("${ARG_LABELS}" MATCHES "Integration")
        list(APPEND ARG_RESOURCE_LOCK "Integration_Serial")
    endif()
    if(ARG_RESOURCE_LOCK)
        set_tests_properties(${TEST_NAME} PROPERTIES
            RESOURCE_LOCK "${ARG_RESOURCE_LOCK}"
        )
    endif()

    # Add TIMEOUT if specified (useful for slow integration/parity tests)
    if(ARG_TIMEOUT)
        set_tests_properties(${TEST_NAME} PROPERTIES
            TIMEOUT ${ARG_TIMEOUT}
        )
    elseif("${ARG_LABELS}" MATCHES "Unit")
        # A unit process should never silently consume the gate for ten minutes
        # or more.  Existing exhaustive CPU policy tests complete inside this
        # five-minute ceiling; larger hardware/model workloads belong in the
        # Integration or Performance suites.
        set_tests_properties(${TEST_NAME} PROPERTIES
            TIMEOUT 300
        )
    endif()
endfunction()

# =============================================================================
# discover_v2_parity_tests() — Focused isolation plus process-resident campaigns
#
# Runs the test binary with --gtest_list_tests at POST_BUILD time (no mpirun),
# parses discovered test cases, and generates isolated CTest entries for focused
# diagnostics. ProductionParity parameters are grouped by exact backend into a
# single all-precision process campaign so immutable real weights are amortized;
# each fixture still rebuilds exact runner, graph, arena, stream, and KV state.
# PRODUCTION_ISOLATED_TESTS accepts literal GTest-name fragments for cells that
# must own a fresh MPI application lifetime. Each match remains a production
# campaign, but receives its own mpirun world instead of sharing a process.
#
# Usage:
#   discover_v2_parity_tests(my_target
#       TEST_PREFIX V2_Integration_Parity_Qwen2_SingleDevice
#       LABELS "V2;Integration;Parity;..."
#       MPI_PROCS 1
#   )
# =============================================================================
function(discover_v2_parity_tests TARGET)
    # In Release mode, parity tests are never perf tests — skip entirely
    if(V2_PERF_TESTS_ONLY)
        return()
    endif()

    # The same executable inventory serves numerical and tagged HTTP discovery.
    # No runner or CI adapter maintains a second list of model binaries.
    if("${TARGET}" MATCHES "^v2_integration_parity_.*_matrix$")
        if(NOT TARGET v2_model_parity_matrices)
            add_custom_target(v2_model_parity_matrices)
        endif()
        add_dependencies(v2_model_parity_matrices ${TARGET})
    endif()

    cmake_parse_arguments(
        ARG
        ""
        "MPI_PROCS;TEST_PREFIX;TIMEOUT;PRODUCTION_PERF_STATS_FILTER"
        "LABELS;MODEL_FILES;CPU_MODEL_FILES;CUDA_MODEL_FILES;ROCM_MODEL_FILES;PRODUCTION_ISOLATED_TESTS"
        ${ARGN})

    if(NOT ARG_TEST_PREFIX)
        set(ARG_TEST_PREFIX "${TARGET}")
    endif()
    if(NOT ARG_MPI_PROCS)
        set(ARG_MPI_PROCS 1)
    endif()

    # Serialize the test-owned model manifest through the POST_BUILD script.
    # A pipe is intentional: semicolons are CMake list separators and would
    # otherwise be expanded into separate command arguments before discovery.
    set(_serialized_model_files "")
    if(ARG_MODEL_FILES)
        string(JOIN "|" _serialized_model_files ${ARG_MODEL_FILES})
    endif()
    set(_serialized_production_isolated_tests "")
    if(ARG_PRODUCTION_ISOLATED_TESTS)
        string(JOIN "|" _serialized_production_isolated_tests
            ${ARG_PRODUCTION_ISOLATED_TESTS})
    endif()
    foreach(_backend IN ITEMS CPU CUDA ROCM)
        set(_backend_model_files "${ARG_${_backend}_MODEL_FILES}")
        set(_serialized_${_backend}_model_files "")
        if(_backend_model_files)
            string(JOIN "|" _serialized_${_backend}_model_files
                ${_backend_model_files})
        endif()
    endforeach()

    # __FILE__ may be emitted as a build-relative path, while discovered tests
    # execute from the repository root.  Publish one configure-time authority
    # for diagnostic artifacts so every direct/CTest launch writes into the
    # canonical parity results tree instead of resolving outside the checkout.
    target_compile_definitions(${TARGET} PRIVATE
        LLAMINAR_PARITY_SOURCE_DIR="${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/integration/parity")

    # Paths for generated artifacts
    set(_ctest_file "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/${TARGET}_discovered_tests.cmake")
    set(_discovery_script "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake/V2ParityTestDiscovery.cmake")

    # The generated CTest include is produced by a POST_BUILD command attached
    # to the test binary. Make the binary relink when the discovery helper
    # changes so stale "Discovery failed" files do not survive script fixes.
    set_property(TARGET ${TARGET} APPEND PROPERTY LINK_DEPENDS "${_discovery_script}")

    # POST_BUILD command-line changes alone do not make an already-linked
    # executable stale in every CMake/Ninja version. Persist every registration
    # input in a content-addressed link dependency so manifest, topology, label,
    # timeout, and PerfStats changes necessarily relink the target and regenerate
    # its CTest include. Avoid rewriting an unchanged file: doing so would make
    # every configure trigger needless parity relinks.
    set(_discovery_identity_file
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/${TARGET}_discovery_identity.txt")
    string(CONCAT _discovery_identity
        "target=${TARGET}\n"
        "test_prefix=${ARG_TEST_PREFIX}\n"
        "labels=${ARG_LABELS}\n"
        "mpi_procs=${ARG_MPI_PROCS}\n"
        "num_sockets=${V2_TEST_SOCKETS}\n"
        "cores_per_socket=${V2_TEST_CORES_PER_SOCKET}\n"
        "timeout=${ARG_TIMEOUT}\n"
        "production_perf_stats_filter=${ARG_PRODUCTION_PERF_STATS_FILTER}\n"
        "production_isolated_tests=${_serialized_production_isolated_tests}\n"
        "model_files=${_serialized_model_files}\n"
        "cpu_model_files=${_serialized_CPU_model_files}\n"
        "cuda_model_files=${_serialized_CUDA_model_files}\n"
        "rocm_model_files=${_serialized_ROCM_model_files}\n")
    set(_existing_discovery_identity "")
    if(EXISTS "${_discovery_identity_file}")
        file(READ "${_discovery_identity_file}" _existing_discovery_identity)
    endif()
    if(NOT _existing_discovery_identity STREQUAL _discovery_identity)
        file(WRITE "${_discovery_identity_file}" "${_discovery_identity}")
    endif()
    set_property(TARGET ${TARGET} APPEND PROPERTY
        LINK_DEPENDS "${_discovery_identity_file}")

    # Working directory: project root (CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR is src/v2, go up two levels)
    get_filename_component(_working_dir "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/../.." ABSOLUTE)

    # POST_BUILD: run discovery script (no mpirun needed, just the binary directly)
    add_custom_command(
        TARGET ${TARGET} POST_BUILD
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND}
            -D "TEST_EXECUTABLE=$<TARGET_FILE:${TARGET}>"
            -D "CTEST_FILE=${_ctest_file}"
            -D "TEST_PREFIX=${ARG_TEST_PREFIX}"
            -D "LABELS=${ARG_LABELS}"
            -D "MPI_PROCS=${ARG_MPI_PROCS}"
            -D "NUM_SOCKETS=${V2_TEST_SOCKETS}"
            -D "CORES_PER_SOCKET=${V2_TEST_CORES_PER_SOCKET}"
            -D "WORKING_DIR=${_working_dir}"
            -D "TIMEOUT=${ARG_TIMEOUT}"
            -D "PRODUCTION_PERF_STATS_FILTER=${ARG_PRODUCTION_PERF_STATS_FILTER}"
            -D "PRODUCTION_ISOLATED_TESTS_SERIALIZED=${_serialized_production_isolated_tests}"
            -D "MODEL_FILES_SERIALIZED=${_serialized_model_files}"
            -D "CPU_MODEL_FILES_SERIALIZED=${_serialized_CPU_model_files}"
            -D "CUDA_MODEL_FILES_SERIALIZED=${_serialized_CUDA_model_files}"
            -D "ROCM_MODEL_FILES_SERIALIZED=${_serialized_ROCM_model_files}"
            -P "${_discovery_script}"
        BYPRODUCTS "${_ctest_file}"
        COMMENT "Discovering parity tests in ${TARGET}..."
        VERBATIM
    )

    # Tell CTest to include the generated file (tests appear after first build)
    set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY TEST_INCLUDE_FILES "${_ctest_file}")

    # Create an empty file so CTest doesn't error before the first build
    if(NOT EXISTS "${_ctest_file}")
        file(WRITE "${_ctest_file}" "# Placeholder — tests will be discovered after building ${TARGET}\n")
    endif()
endfunction()

# =============================================================================
# Unit Tests
# =============================================================================
# Fast, isolated tests for individual components (tensors, kernels, etc.)
# No model loading, no MPI (or single-rank MPI only)
# Naming convention: Test files use CamelCase format Test__ClassName.cpp

# Find GTest (should be available from parent CMake)
find_package(GTest REQUIRED)

# Enable pipeline snapshot capture for test builds (matches core library)
# This compile definition enables the snapshot infrastructure in PipelineBase.
# In release builds (without this flag), all snapshot code compiles away to NOOPs.
# CRITICAL: Must match core library definition to avoid ODR violations!
# We also set a CMake variable for conditional test registration.
if(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE MATCHES "Debug")
    add_compile_definitions(ENABLE_PIPELINE_SNAPSHOTS)
    set(ENABLE_PIPELINE_SNAPSHOTS TRUE)
elseif(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE MATCHES "Integration")
    add_compile_definitions(ENABLE_PIPELINE_SNAPSHOTS)
    set(ENABLE_PIPELINE_SNAPSHOTS TRUE)
elseif(ENABLE_SNAPSHOTS)
    add_compile_definitions(ENABLE_PIPELINE_SNAPSHOTS)
    set(ENABLE_PIPELINE_SNAPSHOTS TRUE)
endif()

# Focused routed-expert policy regressions. These suites use typed device
# addresses and mock collective contexts only; physical GPU work belongs in the
# integration gate and must never be introduced into these unit targets.
function(add_v2_routed_expert_policy_unit TARGET_NAME TEST_NAME SOURCE_FILE)
    add_executable(${TARGET_NAME} ${SOURCE_FILE})
    target_include_directories(${TARGET_NAME} PRIVATE
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
    )
    target_link_libraries(${TARGET_NAME}
        llaminar2_core
        GTest::gtest
        GTest::gtest_main
    )
    add_v2_test(${TEST_NAME}
        COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:${TARGET_NAME}>
        LABELS "V2;Unit;Execution;MoE;RoutedExpertPlacement;Regression"
        MPI_PROCS 1
        NO_MODELS
    )
endfunction()

# Cross-vendor integration tests (require both CUDA and ROCm)
if(HAVE_CUDA AND HAVE_ROCM)

    # Process-isolated emitters for the heterogeneous ExpertOverlay arithmetic
    # contract.  CUDA and HIP runtimes are deliberately never initialized in
    # the same process; the Python integration gate joins their exact FP32 CSVs
    # and byte sidecars while retaining both sets as diagnostic artifacts.
    set(CROSS_VENDOR_MOE_ARITHMETIC_SOURCE
        integration/kernels/moe/CrossVendorNativeVNNIArithmeticEmitter.cpp)
    add_executable(v2_cross_vendor_moe_arithmetic_cuda

        LLAMINAR_CROSS_VENDOR_ARITHMETIC_CUDA=1)
    target_link_libraries(v2_cross_vendor_moe_arithmetic_cuda PRIVATE
        llaminar2_core CUDA::cudart)

    add_executable(v2_cross_vendor_moe_arithmetic_rocm
        ${CROSS_VENDOR_MOE_ARITHMETIC_SOURCE})
    target_compile_definitions(v2_cross_vendor_moe_arithmetic_rocm PRIVATE
        LLAMINAR_CROSS_VENDOR_ARITHMETIC_ROCM=1)
    target_link_libraries(v2_cross_vendor_moe_arithmetic_rocm PRIVATE
        llaminar2_core)

    add_v2_test(V2_Integration_CrossVendor_MoE_AllCodebooks_ArithmeticParity
        COMMAND ${Python3_EXECUTABLE}
            ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/integration/kernels/moe/compare_cross_vendor_native_vnni_arithmetic.py
            --cuda-emitter $<TARGET_FILE:v2_cross_vendor_moe_arithmetic_cuda>

            --output-dir ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/cross_vendor_moe_arithmetic_evidence
        LABELS "V2;Integration;CUDA;ROCm;CrossVendor;Kernels;MoE;ExpertOverlay;Parity;AllFormats;AllCodebooks;NativeVNNI;PreparedWeights;DecodeEquivalent;DeviceResident;Regression"

# The learned-dispatch fitter evaluates millions of exact leaf objectives and
# legal feature splits. ABI v7 keeps the full top-64 tree beam on CUDA or ROCm,
# including canonical p95 gates, complete objective ordering, exact structural
# deduplication, compact index-only selection, graph replay, and every leaf
# budget. Keep one DSO per vendor: a policy worker
# loads exactly one runtime and binds to one physical accelerator, avoiding
# CUDA/HIP startup interaction in-process.
if(HAVE_CUDA)
    add_library(v2_native_vnni_leaf_primary_scorer_cuda SHARED
        performance/kernels/native_vnni_dispatch/CUDANativeVNNILeafPrimaryScorer.cu
    )
    target_include_directories(v2_native_vnni_leaf_primary_scorer_cuda PRIVATE
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/performance/kernels/native_vnni_dispatch
    )
    target_link_libraries(v2_native_vnni_leaf_primary_scorer_cuda PRIVATE
        CUDA::cudart
    )
    target_compile_options(v2_native_vnni_leaf_primary_scorer_cuda PRIVATE
        $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CUDA>:-O3;--fmad=false;--ftz=false;--prec-div=true;--prec-sqrt=true>
    )
    set_target_properties(v2_native_vnni_leaf_primary_scorer_cuda PROPERTIES
        OUTPUT_NAME llaminar_native_vnni_leaf_primary_scorer_cuda
        CXX_VISIBILITY_PRESET hidden
        CUDA_VISIBILITY_PRESET hidden
        VISIBILITY_INLINES_HIDDEN YES
    )
endif()

if(HAVE_ROCM)
    set_source_files_properties(
        performance/kernels/native_vnni_dispatch/ROCmNativeVNNILeafPrimaryScorer.hip
        PROPERTIES LANGUAGE HIP
    )
    add_library(v2_native_vnni_leaf_primary_scorer_rocm SHARED
        performance/kernels/native_vnni_dispatch/ROCmNativeVNNILeafPrimaryScorer.hip
    )
    target_include_directories(v2_native_vnni_leaf_primary_scorer_rocm PRIVATE
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/performance/kernels/native_vnni_dispatch
    )
    target_link_libraries(v2_native_vnni_leaf_primary_scorer_rocm PRIVATE
        hip::host
        hip::device
    )
    target_compile_options(v2_native_vnni_leaf_primary_scorer_rocm PRIVATE
        $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:HIP>:-O3;-fno-fast-math;-ffp-contract=off>
    )
    set_target_properties(v2_native_vnni_leaf_primary_scorer_rocm PROPERTIES
        OUTPUT_NAME llaminar_native_vnni_leaf_primary_scorer_rocm
        CXX_VISIBILITY_PRESET hidden
        HIP_VISIBILITY_PRESET hidden
        VISIBILITY_INLINES_HIDDEN YES
    )
endif()

# GPU execution belongs in Integration, never Unit. Each CTest process loads

foreach(V2_SPILL_LANGUAGE CUDA HIP)
    if(CMAKE_${V2_SPILL_LANGUAGE}_COMPILER)
        set(V2_SPILL_PROOF "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/v2_gpu_spill_compilation_${V2_SPILL_LANGUAGE}.json")
        set(V2_SPILL_SCRIPT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/integration/build/test_gpu_spill_compilation.py")
        # Compiler probes are build work. Runtime-derived installed test images
        # have no SDK, so preflight verifies their complete source-bound proof.
        # Changes to policy, probe, compiler or target set rerun the real probes.
        add_custom_command(OUTPUT "${V2_SPILL_PROOF}"
            COMMAND ${Python3_EXECUTABLE} "${V2_SPILL_SCRIPT}" compile
                --report "${V2_SPILL_PROOF}"
                --language ${V2_SPILL_LANGUAGE}
                --compiler ${CMAKE_${V2_SPILL_LANGUAGE}_COMPILER}
                --architectures "${CMAKE_${V2_SPILL_LANGUAGE}_ARCHITECTURES}"
                --cmake ${CMAKE_COMMAND} --ninja ${CMAKE_MAKE_PROGRAM}
            DEPENDS "${V2_SPILL_SCRIPT}"
                integration/build/CMakeLists.txt
                integration/build/gpu_spill_probe.cu
                integration/build/gpu_spill_probe.hip
                ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../cmake/GpuSpillGuard.cmake
                ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../scripts/build/gpu_spill_guard.py
                ${CMAKE_${V2_SPILL_LANGUAGE}_COMPILER}
            VERBATIM
        )
        add_custom_target(v2_gpu_spill_compilation_${V2_SPILL_LANGUAGE}
            DEPENDS "${V2_SPILL_PROOF}")
        add_test(NAME V2_Integration_GPUSpillCompilation_${V2_SPILL_LANGUAGE}
            COMMAND ${Python3_EXECUTABLE}
                "${V2_SPILL_SCRIPT}" verify --report "${V2_SPILL_PROOF}"
                --language ${V2_SPILL_LANGUAGE}
                --compiler ${CMAKE_${V2_SPILL_LANGUAGE}_COMPILER}
                --architectures "${CMAKE_${V2_SPILL_LANGUAGE}_ARCHITECTURES}"
        )
        set_property(GLOBAL PROPERTY
            V2_TEST_BUILD_TARGETS_V2_Integration_GPUSpillCompilation_${V2_SPILL_LANGUAGE}
            v2_gpu_spill_compilation_${V2_SPILL_LANGUAGE})
        set_tests_properties(V2_Integration_GPUSpillCompilation_${V2_SPILL_LANGUAGE} PROPERTIES
            LABELS "V2;Integration;ProductionTestPreflight;Build;Regression"
            TIMEOUT 120
        )
    endif()
endforeach()

# Profiler evidence is a large pure-Python regression module. Eight disjoint
# shards keep the slowest focused shard comfortably below the unit-test timeout,

# shard's internal process-pool work.

     "${NATIVE_VNNI_PROFILER_EVIDENCE_SHARD_COUNT} - 1")

                LLAMINAR_UNIT_SHARD_INDEX=${SHARD_INDEX}

endforeach()

# The NativeVNNI Python suite exercises process pools, NumPy/BLAS code, compiler
# probes, and subprocess-based artifact validation.  Raw add_test() calls
# otherwise consume one CTest slot, which lets the canonical `ctest --parallel`
# gate launch roughly sixty CPU-active trainer tests on 56 physical cores.
# Match add_v2_test()'s accounting so the suite remains parallel without
# oversubscribing both hardware threads on every physical core.
get_property(NATIVE_VNNI_UNIT_TESTS DIRECTORY PROPERTY TESTS)
foreach(NATIVE_VNNI_UNIT_TEST IN LISTS NATIVE_VNNI_UNIT_TESTS)
    if(NATIVE_VNNI_UNIT_TEST MATCHES "^V2_Unit_.*NativeVNNI")
        set_tests_properties(${NATIVE_VNNI_UNIT_TEST} PROPERTIES PROCESSORS 4)
    endif()
endforeach()

# These tests intentionally create nested worker pools or run the largest
# policy reductions. Reserve sixteen physical cores here; the final Unit-test
# normalization below translates that reservation into the host's logical
# CTest slots. The numerical-Python tests are also affinity-bound below, so
# their affinity-aware process-pool defaults cannot silently exceed the same
# reservation advertised to CTest.
set(NATIVE_VNNI_HEAVY_UNIT_TESTS
    V2_Unit_CUDANativeVNNIDecodeTrainer
    V2_Unit_CPUNativeVNNIVerifierTrainer
    V2_Unit_NativeVNNICommonDispatchPolicy
    V2_Unit_NativeVNNIProductionMoEPrefillSweep
)
foreach(SHARD_INDEX RANGE 0 ${NATIVE_VNNI_PROFILER_EVIDENCE_LAST_SHARD})
    list(APPEND NATIVE_VNNI_HEAVY_UNIT_TESTS
         V2_Unit_NativeVNNIProfilerEvidence_${SHARD_INDEX})
endforeach()
set_tests_properties(${NATIVE_VNNI_HEAVY_UNIT_TESTS} PROPERTIES PROCESSORS 16)

# Importing NumPy, SciPy, and scikit-learn loads two independent OpenBLAS
# runtimes plus libgomp. Left unconstrained, one tiny Python unit process on the
# canonical host creates 127 numerical-library threads before an
# affinity-aware NativeVNNI process pool is considered. Several such tests can
# therefore turn a five-second focused regression into a timeout even though
# their CTest PROCESSORS declarations are otherwise correct.
#
# Keep process-level parallelism authoritative for these pure-policy tests:
# CTest assigns the advertised CPU set, every child inherits that affinity,
# and the NativeVNNI worker-count helpers derive their physical-core cap from
# that exact set. Numerical libraries stay single-threaded inside each worker,
# preventing a nested threads-times-processes explosion while preserving every
# parallel-policy assertion in the tests themselves.
set(NATIVE_VNNI_NUMERICAL_PYTHON_UNIT_TESTS
    V2_Unit_CPUNativeVNNIDecodeSealedPlan
    V2_Unit_CPUNativeVNNIDecodeTrainer
    V2_Unit_CPUNativeVNNIGroupedSealedPlan
    V2_Unit_CPUNativeVNNIPrefillTrainer
    V2_Unit_CPUNativeVNNIPrefillTrainingPlan
    V2_Unit_CPUNativeVNNIVerifierTrainer
    V2_Unit_CUDANativeVNNIDecodeTrainer
    V2_Unit_NativeVNNICommonDispatchPolicy
    V2_Unit_NativeVNNIDispatchRefreshScript
    V2_Unit_NativeVNNIPairedRequests
    V2_Unit_NativeVNNIProductionMoEPrefillSweep
    V2_Unit_NativeVNNIProfilerDiagnostics
    V2_Unit_ROCmNativeVNNIDecodeTrainer
)
foreach(SHARD_INDEX RANGE 0 ${NATIVE_VNNI_PROFILER_EVIDENCE_LAST_SHARD})
    list(APPEND NATIVE_VNNI_NUMERICAL_PYTHON_UNIT_TESTS
         V2_Unit_NativeVNNIProfilerEvidence_${SHARD_INDEX})
endforeach()
set_tests_properties(${NATIVE_VNNI_NUMERICAL_PYTHON_UNIT_TESTS} PROPERTIES
    PROCESSOR_AFFINITY TRUE
)
set_property(TEST ${NATIVE_VNNI_NUMERICAL_PYTHON_UNIT_TESTS}
    APPEND PROPERTY ENVIRONMENT
    "OMP_NUM_THREADS=1"
    "OMP_DYNAMIC=false"
    "OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1"
    "MKL_NUM_THREADS=1"
    "MKL_DYNAMIC=false"
    "NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS=1"
    "BLIS_NUM_THREADS=1"
    "VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS=1"
    "LLAMINAR_FORCE_CPU_ONLY_STARTUP=1"
)

# Test: TransferEngine copyActivation - tensor→tensor copy transport selection (requires GPU)
if(HAVE_CUDA OR HAVE_ROCM)
    # PMA observations come from the production MPI inventory, even for one
    # rank. The shared main also retires GPU workers before finalizing MPI.
    add_executable(v2_integration_captured_transfer_channel
        integration/transfer/Test__CapturedTransferChannel.cpp
        integration/transfer/Test__DeviceCountedTransferChannel.cpp
        integration/mpi_gtest_main.cpp)
    if(TARGET v2_integration_captured_transfer_channel AND HAVE_CUDA)
        target_sources(v2_integration_captured_transfer_channel PRIVATE integration/transfer/CountedChannelTestKernels.cu)
    endif()
    if(TARGET v2_integration_captured_transfer_channel AND HAVE_ROCM)
        set_source_files_properties(integration/transfer/CountedChannelTestKernels.hip PROPERTIES LANGUAGE HIP)
        target_sources(v2_integration_captured_transfer_channel PRIVATE integration/transfer/CountedChannelTestKernels.hip)
    endif()
    v2_test_device_scope(v2_integration_captured_transfer_channel FullInventory)
    target_link_libraries(v2_integration_captured_transfer_channel llaminar2_core GTest::gtest)
    # Economy probes remain separate from functional ProductionTestPreflight.
    add_executable(v2_perf_moe_compact_intermediate
        performance/transfer/Perf__MoECompactIntermediate.cpp integration/mpi_gtest_main.cpp)
    v2_test_device_scope(v2_perf_moe_compact_intermediate FullInventory)
    target_link_libraries(v2_perf_moe_compact_intermediate PRIVATE llaminar2_core GTest::gtest)
    foreach(_compact_backend CUDA ROCm)
        if((_compact_backend STREQUAL "CUDA" AND HAVE_CUDA) OR (_compact_backend STREQUAL "ROCm" AND HAVE_ROCM))
            add_v2_test(V2_Perf_MoECompactIntermediate_${_compact_backend}2
                COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:v2_perf_moe_compact_intermediate>
                    --gtest_filter=MoECompactIntermediateEconomy.${_compact_backend}2
                LABELS "V2;Performance;MoE;Transfer;GraphCapture;${_compact_backend}"
                MPI_PROCS 1 NO_MODELS TIMEOUT 180)
        endif()
    endforeach()
    foreach(_channel_pair CUDA_CUDA ROCm_ROCm CUDA_ROCm ROCm_CUDA)
        if((_channel_pair STREQUAL "CUDA_CUDA" AND HAVE_CUDA) OR
           (_channel_pair STREQUAL "ROCm_ROCm" AND HAVE_ROCM) OR
           (HAVE_CUDA AND HAVE_ROCM))
            # Gate scheduling consumes exact backend capability labels. A
            # combined spelling alone would misclassify this as host-only.
            string(REPLACE "_" ";" _channel_backends "${_channel_pair}")
            list(REMOVE_DUPLICATES _channel_backends)
            add_v2_test(V2_Integration_CapturedTransferChannel_${_channel_pair}
                COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:v2_integration_captured_transfer_channel>
                    --gtest_filter=CapturedTransferChannelDevices.${_channel_pair}_RetainedRoundTrip
                LABELS "V2;Integration;ProductionTestPreflight;Transfer;GraphCapture;GPU;${_channel_backends};Regression"
                TIMEOUT 120
                MPI_PROCS 1
                NO_MODELS
            )
            add_v2_test(V2_Integration_CapturedWorkspaceTransfer_${_channel_pair}
                COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:v2_integration_captured_transfer_channel>
                    --gtest_filter=CapturedTransferChannelDevices.${_channel_pair}_RetainedWorkspaceRoundTrip
                LABELS "V2;Integration;ProductionTestPreflight;Transfer;Memory;GraphCapture;GPU;${_channel_backends};Regression"
                TIMEOUT 120
                MPI_PROCS 1
                NO_MODELS
            )
            add_v2_test(V2_Integration_DeviceCountedTransferChannel_${_channel_pair}
                COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:v2_integration_captured_transfer_channel>
                    --gtest_filter=DeviceCountedTransferChannel.${_channel_pair}
                LABELS "V2;Integration;ProductionTestPreflight;Transfer;Memory;GraphCapture;GPU;${_channel_backends};Regression"
                TIMEOUT 120 MPI_PROCS 1 NO_MODELS)
            add_v2_test(V2_Integration_FusedTransferChannel_${_channel_pair}
                COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:v2_integration_captured_transfer_channel>
                    --gtest_filter=DeviceCountedTransferChannel.${_channel_pair}_FusedBoundaries
                LABELS "V2;Integration;ProductionTestPreflight;Transfer;Memory;GraphCapture;GPU;${_channel_backends};Regression"
                TIMEOUT 120 MPI_PROCS 1 NO_MODELS)
        endif()
    endforeach()
endif()

# This test certifies physical page ownership, rather than a policy request.
# Linux may legally fall back to another node when a concurrently running
# unit-test process puts the requested node below its allocation watermarks;
# NUMAAllocator correctly rejects that spill instead of publishing it.  Run the
# small proof alone so the unrestricted Unit fan-out cannot manufacture that
# external-capacity condition.  The assertion remains exact: this does not
# relax the production placement contract.
if(TEST V2_Unit_NUMAAllocator)
    set_tests_properties(V2_Unit_NUMAAllocator PROPERTIES RUN_SERIAL TRUE)
endif()

if(TARGET v2_test_numa_allocator)
    # Production defect: a rank may inherit a remote preferred memory policy,
    # and affinity-only first touch must not place CPU expert weights there.
    add_test(NAME V2_Integration_NUMAFirstTouchPolicyIsolation
        COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:v2_test_numa_allocator>
                --gtest_filter=Test__NUMAAllocator.FirstTouchOverridesInheritedRemoteMemoryPolicy
    )
    set_tests_properties(V2_Integration_NUMAFirstTouchPolicyIsolation PROPERTIES
        LABELS "V2;Integration;ProductionTestPreflight;CPU;NUMA;Memory;Regression"
        RUN_SERIAL TRUE
        TIMEOUT 30
    )
endif()

# =============================================================================
# SIMD Path Equivalency Tests (Phase 1: Q4_0, Q4_1, Q5_0, Q5_1, Q6_K)
# =============================================================================
# These tests validate that scalar, AVX2, and AVX512 dequantization paths
# produce identical results for quantized tensors with SIMD optimizations.
# Tests use direct method calls (decodeBlockScalar, decodeBlockAVX2, decodeBlockAVX512)
# with synthetic test data to ensure numerical equivalency across all code paths.

# Test: Q4_0 SIMD Equivalency
add_executable(v2_test_q4_0_simd integration/tensors/Test__Q4_0Tensor.cpp)
target_link_libraries(v2_test_q4_0_simd 
    llaminar2_core 
    GTest::gtest
    GTest::gtest_main
)
add_v2_test(V2_Integration_Q4_0_SIMD

    MPI_PROCS 1  # Tests RCCL locally - single rank

# RCCL driver has a known heap corruption bug ("double free or corruption")
# that intermittently triggers glibc abort() DURING test execution.
# glibc abort() forcibly resets SIGABRT to SIG_DFL before raising, so signal
# handlers cannot catch it. Use PASS_REGULAR_EXPRESSION as the only reliable
# workaround — CTest passes if GTest printed "[ PASSED ]" before the crash.
if(TEST V2_Integration_RCCLAllreduceAccuracy)
set_tests_properties(V2_Integration_RCCLAllreduceAccuracy PROPERTIES
    PASS_REGULAR_EXPRESSION "\\[  PASSED  \\]"
)
endif()
message(STATUS "V2 Tests: Added RCCL allreduce accuracy integration tests")
endif()

# =============================================================================
# PARITY TESTS (integration/parity/)
# =============================================================================
# Standardized parity tests comparing Llaminar backends against PyTorch ground truth.
# All tests use ParityTestBase for consistent metrics, visualization, and assertions.
#
# Test Organization:
#   - Test__CUDA_vs_PyTorch.cpp - CUDA pipeline vs PyTorch FP32 reference
#   - Test__CPU_vs_PyTorch.cpp  - CPU pipeline vs PyTorch FP32 reference
#   - Test__ROCm_vs_PyTorch.cpp - ROCm pipeline vs PyTorch FP32 reference
#
# Requirements:
#   - ZLIB (for cnpy .npy file loading)
#   - PyTorch snapshots generated by python/reference/generate_qwen_pipeline_snapshots.py

find_package(ZLIB QUIET)
if(ZLIB_FOUND)
    get_filename_component(WORKSPACE_ROOT_PARITY "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../.." ABSOLUTE)

    # Auto-clone cnpy if missing (small header + single .cpp for .npy file loading).
    # cnpy is .gitignored under external/ so fresh checkouts (and Docker builds that
    # COPY only src/+tests/) won't have it. Clone shallowly when needed.
    set(CNPY_DIR "${WORKSPACE_ROOT_PARITY}/external/cnpy")
    if(NOT EXISTS "${CNPY_DIR}/cnpy.cpp")
        find_package(Git REQUIRED)
        message(STATUS "V2 Tests: cnpy not found in external/, cloning https://github.com/rogersce/cnpy.git ...")
        if(NOT EXISTS "${WORKSPACE_ROOT_PARITY}/external")
            file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${WORKSPACE_ROOT_PARITY}/external")
        endif()
        execute_process(
            COMMAND ${GIT_EXECUTABLE} clone --depth 1 https://github.com/rogersce/cnpy.git cnpy
            WORKING_DIRECTORY "${WORKSPACE_ROOT_PARITY}/external"
            RESULT_VARIABLE CNPY_CLONE_RESULT
            ERROR_VARIABLE CNPY_CLONE_ERROR
        )
        if(NOT CNPY_CLONE_RESULT EQUAL 0)
            message(WARNING "V2 Tests: Failed to clone cnpy: ${CNPY_CLONE_ERROR}\n  Parity tests will be disabled.")
        endif()
    endif()

    if(NOT EXISTS "${CNPY_DIR}/cnpy.cpp")
        message(WARNING "V2 Tests: cnpy unavailable; skipping parity test executables")
    else()

    # Unit: exact metadata-to-VRAM envelope used before parity graph capture.
    add_executable(v2_test_typed_npy_snapshot
        unit/parity/Test__TypedNpySnapshot.cpp ${CNPY_DIR}/cnpy.cpp)
    target_link_libraries(v2_test_typed_npy_snapshot PRIVATE llaminar2_core GTest::gtest_main ZLIB::ZLIB)
    target_include_directories(v2_test_typed_npy_snapshot PRIVATE ${CNPY_DIR})
    add_v2_test(V2_Unit_TypedNpySnapshot
        COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:v2_test_typed_npy_snapshot>
        LABELS "V2;Unit;Parity;Snapshots;Regression" MPI_PROCS 1 NO_MPI NO_MODELS)
    add_v2_test(V2_Integration_ExactIntegerNpySnapshots
        COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:v2_test_typed_npy_snapshot>
        LABELS "V2;Integration;ProductionTestPreflight;DeviceFree;Parity;Snapshots;Regression" MPI_PROCS 1 NO_MPI NO_MODELS)

    add_executable(v2_test_parity_snapshot_memory_capacity
        unit/parity/Test__ParitySnapshotMemoryCapacity.cpp
        ${CNPY_DIR}/cnpy.cpp
    )
    target_link_libraries(v2_test_parity_snapshot_memory_capacity
        llaminar2_core GTest::gtest GTest::gtest_main ZLIB::ZLIB
    )
    target_include_directories(v2_test_parity_snapshot_memory_capacity PRIVATE
        ${CNPY_DIR}
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
    )
    add_v2_test(V2_Unit_ParitySnapshotMemoryCapacity
        COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:v2_test_parity_snapshot_memory_capacity>
        LABELS "V2;Unit;Parity;Snapshots;PhysicalMemoryAuthority;NoModels"
        MPI_PROCS 1
        NO_MODELS
        TIMEOUT 30
    )

    # Real-weight inputs are declared beside parity registration so the
    # aggregate campaign can stage the exact selected corpus into tmpfs before
    # any backend starts. Runtime tests validate their configured GGUF against
    # this manifest, making a stale registration a hard failure.
    set(V2_PARITY_MODEL_QWEN2_Q4
        "${WORKSPACE_ROOT_PARITY}/models/qwen2.5-0.5b-instruct-q4_0.gguf")
    set(V2_PARITY_MODEL_QWEN2_Q8

    # =========================================================================

    # QFN paired-source admission registration begins here. Its source closure
    # and target scope follow the same Release selection as test creation.
    v2_test_device_scope(v2_integration_qwen4exp_mtp_admission DeclaredBackends)

    # No per-case source extension exists in discover_v2_parity_tests. Independent
    # manual registrations expose the exact source closure without altering any
    # main20 process campaign. add_v2_test owns MPI/startup/Integration_Serial policy.
    set(_qfn_mtp_admission_files ${V2_PARITY_MODEL_QWEN_FLASH_NEXT}
        "/opt/llaminar-models/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GGUF/MTP/mtp-Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-shared-Q8_0.gguf")
    list(LENGTH _qfn_mtp_admission_files _qfn_mtp_admission_file_count)
    if(NOT _qfn_mtp_admission_file_count EQUAL 5)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "QFN sidecar admission requires original4main shards +explicit predictor")
    endif()
    foreach(_qfn_topology CPU0 CUDA0_CPU0_ExpertOverlay ROCm0_CPU0_ExpertOverlay CUDA0_ROCm0_CPU0_PP)
        if(_qfn_topology MATCHES "CUDA" AND NOT HAVE_CUDA)
            continue()
        endif()
        if(_qfn_topology MATCHES "ROCm" AND NOT HAVE_ROCM)
            continue()
        endif()
        set(_qfn_labels "V2;Integration;RealModel;FullModel;Qwen4Exp;MTP;Admission;CPU")
        set(_qfn_skip_cuda 1)
        set(_qfn_skip_rocm 1)
        set(_qfn_cpu_only 1)
        if(_qfn_topology MATCHES "CUDA")
            list(APPEND _qfn_labels CUDA)
            set(_qfn_skip_cuda 0)
            set(_qfn_cpu_only 0)
        endif()
        if(_qfn_topology MATCHES "ROCm")
            list(APPEND _qfn_labels ROCm)
            set(_qfn_skip_rocm 0)
            set(_qfn_cpu_only 0)
        endif()
        set(_qfn_overlay_suffix "")
        if(_qfn_topology MATCHES "ExpertOverlay")
            set(_qfn_overlay_suffix "Static_Ordinal_")
        endif()
        foreach(_qfn_storage RAM Mmap)
            set(_qfn_cell "Qwen38FlashNext_UDQ4KXL_${_qfn_topology}_Ngram${_qfn_storage}_${_qfn_overlay_suffix}ActFP32_KVFP16_MTPR1Fixed1Retained1")
            set(_qfn_test "V2_Integration_Qwen4ExpMTPAdmission_${_qfn_topology}_${_qfn_storage}")
            add_v2_test(${_qfn_test}
                COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:v2_integration_qwen4exp_mtp_admission>
                    "--gtest_filter=Qwen4ExpMTPAdmission/Qwen4ExpMTPAdmissionTest.PairedSourceInitializesWithoutReferencePack/${_qfn_cell}"
                LABELS ${_qfn_labels} MPI_PROCS 1 TIMEOUT 900
                REQUIRED_FILES ${_qfn_mtp_admission_files}
                ENVIRONMENT "LLAMINAR_FORCE_CPU_ONLY_STARTUP=${_qfn_cpu_only}"
                    "LLAMINAR_SKIP_CUDA_STARTUP=${_qfn_skip_cuda}"
                    "LLAMINAR_SKIP_ROCM_STARTUP=${_qfn_skip_rocm}")
        endforeach()
    endforeach()
    add_v2_test(V2_Integration_Qwen4ExpMTPAdmission_ExplicitNoMTP
        COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:v2_integration_qwen4exp_mtp_admission>
            --gtest_filter=Qwen4ExpMTPPairedSourceControl.CPU0MmapExplicitNoMTP

    # =========================================================================

# produces equivalent results to the legacy imperative pipeline code.
# Part of Phase 4: Integration Testing & Parity Verification for Full Graph Inference.

# Test: Pipeline vs LayerExecutor Q8_1 Parity
# Validates that the LayerExecutor framework produces equivalent results
# to the legacy pipeline code when BOTH use Q8_1 activation precision.
# Uses looser tolerances to account for quantization noise inherent to Q8_1.

# Test: Q8_1 MPI Tensor-Parallel Attention
# Tests the MPI tensor-parallel path for Q8_1 attention:
#   - Head slicing (sliceQ8_1HeadBlocks)
#   - K/V GQA broadcast (broadcastQ8_1KVHeads)
#   - Fused attention kernel execution
#   - Allgatherv result combination

# Test: Precision-Aware MPI Allreduce Integration Tests
# Tests actual MPI communication for FP32, FP16, BF16, Q8_1, and Q16_1 formats
# Validates correctness of partial sum accumulation across ranks
add_executable(v2_integration_mpi_precision_allreduce integration/utils/mpi/Test__MPI_PrecisionAwareAllreduce.cpp)
target_link_libraries(v2_integration_mpi_precision_allreduce
    llaminar2_core
    GTest::gtest
)
add_v2_test(V2_Integration_MPI_PrecisionAwareAllreduce
    COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:v2_integration_mpi_precision_allreduce>
    MPI_PROCS 2
    LABELS "V2;Integration;MPI;Allreduce;FP32;FP16;BF16;Q8_1;Q16_1;Bandwidth"
)

# Test: Sharded KV Cache (Phase 6 - Tensor Parallelism Memory Optimization)
# Tests sharded KV cache where each MPI rank stores only its local KV heads.
# Validates:
# - Each rank creates independent local cache (no MPI communication needed)
# - Tensor shapes are reduced proportionally (local_n_kv_heads * head_dim)
# - Append/clear operations work independently per rank

# - All precisions (FP32, BF16, FP16, Q8_1) work correctly

# Integration Test: CPU NativeVNNI GEMV/GEMM Correctness (Q4_0, IQ4_NL)
add_executable(v2_integration_cpu_native_vnni_verifier_workers
    integration/kernels/cpu/native_vnni/Test__CPUNativeVNNIVerifierWorkers.cpp
    integration/kernels/cpu/native_vnni/Test__CPUNativeVNNIProjectionCapacity.cpp)
target_link_libraries(v2_integration_cpu_native_vnni_verifier_workers PRIVATE
    llaminar2_core GTest::gtest GTest::gtest_main)
target_include_directories(v2_integration_cpu_native_vnni_verifier_workers PRIVATE
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
foreach(V2_VERIFIER_WORKER_ISA AVX2 AVX512)
    if(V2_VERIFIER_WORKER_ISA STREQUAL "AVX512" AND NOT LLAMINAR_CPU_ISA_UPPER STREQUAL "AVX512")
        continue()
    endif()
    string(TOLOWER "${V2_VERIFIER_WORKER_ISA}" V2_VERIFIER_WORKER_RUNTIME_ISA)
    add_v2_test(V2_Integration_CPU_NativeVNNIProjectionCapacity_${V2_VERIFIER_WORKER_ISA}
        COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:v2_integration_cpu_native_vnni_verifier_workers>
            --gtest_filter=CPUNativeVNNIProjectionCapacity.*
        LABELS "V2;Integration;ProductionTestPreflight;CPU;NativeVNNI;MoE;AllFormats;${V2_VERIFIER_WORKER_ISA};ByteExact;Regression"
        MPI_PROCS 1 NO_MODELS
        ENVIRONMENT "LLAMINAR_ISA_LEVEL=${V2_VERIFIER_WORKER_RUNTIME_ISA}")
    list(APPEND V2_PRODUCTION_TEST_PREFLIGHT_TESTS V2_Integration_CPU_NativeVNNIProjectionCapacity_${V2_VERIFIER_WORKER_ISA})
    add_v2_test(V2_Integration_CPU_NativeVNNIVerifierWorkers_${V2_VERIFIER_WORKER_ISA}
        COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:v2_integration_cpu_native_vnni_verifier_workers> --gtest_brief=1
            --gtest_filter=-CPUNativeVNNIVerifierWorkers.DisabledDiagnosticsDoNotAllocate:CPUNativeVNNIVerifierWorkers.MixedFormatExpertTransactionPreservesEveryProjection
        LABELS "V2;Integration;ProductionTestPreflight;CPU;NativeVNNI;MTP;AllFormats;${V2_VERIFIER_WORKER_ISA};ByteExact;Regression"
        MPI_PROCS 1
        NO_MODELS
        ENVIRONMENT "LLAMINAR_ISA_LEVEL=${V2_VERIFIER_WORKER_RUNTIME_ISA};LLAMINAR_PERF_STATS_JSON=1;LLAMINAR_PERF_STATS_FILTER=kernel.cpu_native_vnni_verifier_worker_tasks")
    # The same all-format FFN proof runs without kernel collection. This catches
    # dormant diagnostic strings/maps allocating before the collector's guard.
    add_v2_test(V2_Integration_CPU_NativeVNNIDisabledDiagnostics_${V2_VERIFIER_WORKER_ISA}
        COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:v2_integration_cpu_native_vnni_verifier_workers>
            --gtest_filter=CPUNativeVNNIVerifierWorkers.DisabledDiagnosticsDoNotAllocate
            --gtest_brief=1
        LABELS "V2;Integration;ProductionTestPreflight;CPU;NativeVNNI;MTP;AllFormats;${V2_VERIFIER_WORKER_ISA};ByteExact;NoAllocation;Regression"
        MPI_PROCS 1
        NO_MODELS
        ENVIRONMENT "LLAMINAR_ISA_LEVEL=${V2_VERIFIER_WORKER_RUNTIME_ISA};LLAMINAR_PERF_STATS_JSON=1;LLAMINAR_PERF_STATS_FILTER=moe")
    add_v2_test(V2_Integration_CPU_NativeVNNIMixedFormatFFN_${V2_VERIFIER_WORKER_ISA}
        COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:v2_integration_cpu_native_vnni_verifier_workers>
            --gtest_filter=CPUNativeVNNIVerifierWorkers.MixedFormatExpertTransactionPreservesEveryProjection
            --gtest_brief=1
        LABELS "V2;Integration;ProductionTestPreflight;CPU;NativeVNNI;MTP;AllFormats;MixedFormats;${V2_VERIFIER_WORKER_ISA};ByteExact;NoAllocation;Regression"
        MPI_PROCS 1
        NO_MODELS
        ENVIRONMENT "LLAMINAR_ISA_LEVEL=${V2_VERIFIER_WORKER_RUNTIME_ISA};LLAMINAR_PERF_STATS_JSON=1;LLAMINAR_PERF_STATS_FILTER=moe")
endforeach()

# The scalar FP32 publication ABI is device-free and header-only. Keep this
# focused proof independent of the backend libraries for inexpensive feedback.
add_executable(v2_test_cpu_explicit_rounding_contract
    unit/kernels/cpu/Test__CPUExplicitRoundingContract.cpp)
target_include_directories(v2_test_cpu_explicit_rounding_contract PRIVATE
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
target_compile_features(v2_test_cpu_explicit_rounding_contract PRIVATE cxx_std_20)
target_link_libraries(v2_test_cpu_explicit_rounding_contract PRIVATE
    GTest::gtest GTest::gtest_main)
add_v2_test(V2_Unit_CPUExplicitRoundingContract
    COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:v2_test_cpu_explicit_rounding_contract>
    LABELS "V2;Unit;CPU;Numerics;ByteExact"
    NO_MODELS NO_MPI MPI_PROCS 1)
set(V2_Q8_FINITE_SCALE_CPU_PREFLIGHT_TESTS)
set(V2_Q8_FINITE_SCALE_CPU_ISAS SCALAR AVX2)
if(LLAMINAR_CPU_ISA_UPPER STREQUAL "AVX512")
    list(APPEND V2_Q8_FINITE_SCALE_CPU_ISAS AVX512)
endif()
foreach(V2_Q8_SCALE_ISA IN LISTS V2_Q8_FINITE_SCALE_CPU_ISAS)
    string(TOLOWER "${V2_Q8_SCALE_ISA}" V2_Q8_SCALE_TARGET_ISA)
    set(V2_Q8_SCALE_TARGET v2_test_q8_finite_scale_contract_${V2_Q8_SCALE_TARGET_ISA})
    # The production header selects SIMD with compiled feature guards and real
    # CPUID, not LLAMINAR_ISA_LEVEL. Compile true ceilings; never stub detection.
    add_executable(${V2_Q8_SCALE_TARGET}
        unit/kernels/cpu/Test__CPUExplicitRoundingContract.cpp)
    target_include_directories(${V2_Q8_SCALE_TARGET} PRIVATE
        ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
    target_compile_features(${V2_Q8_SCALE_TARGET} PRIVATE cxx_std_20)
    target_link_libraries(${V2_Q8_SCALE_TARGET} PRIVATE GTest::gtest GTest::gtest_main)
    target_compile_definitions(${V2_Q8_SCALE_TARGET} PRIVATE
        LLAMINAR_Q8_SCALE_TEST_${V2_Q8_SCALE_ISA}=1)
    if(V2_Q8_SCALE_ISA STREQUAL "SCALAR")
        target_compile_options(${V2_Q8_SCALE_TARGET} PRIVATE
            -mno-avx -mno-avx2 -mno-avx512f -mno-fma)
    elseif(V2_Q8_SCALE_ISA STREQUAL "AVX2")
        target_compile_options(${V2_Q8_SCALE_TARGET} PRIVATE
            -mavx2 -mfma -mno-avx512f)
    else()
        target_compile_options(${V2_Q8_SCALE_TARGET} PRIVATE
            -mavx512f -mavx512bw -mavx512vl -mavx512dq -mfma)
    endif()
    add_v2_test(V2_Integration_Q8FiniteScaleContract_CPU_${V2_Q8_SCALE_ISA}
        COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:${V2_Q8_SCALE_TARGET}>
            --gtest_filter=CPUExplicitRoundingContract.Q8FiniteScale*
        LABELS "V2;Integration;CPU;${V2_Q8_SCALE_ISA};Quantization;Numerics;ScaleRange;Regression"
        NO_MODELS NO_MPI MPI_PROCS 1)
    list(APPEND V2_Q8_FINITE_SCALE_CPU_PREFLIGHT_TESTS
        V2_Integration_Q8FiniteScaleContract_CPU_${V2_Q8_SCALE_ISA})
endforeach()
foreach(_fp32_subnormal_isa IN ITEMS SCALAR AVX2 AVX512)
    string(TOLOWER "${_fp32_subnormal_isa}" _fp32_subnormal_isa_lower)
    if(TARGET v2_test_q8_finite_scale_contract_${_fp32_subnormal_isa_lower})
        add_v2_test(V2_Integration_FP32SubnormalContract_CPU_${_fp32_subnormal_isa}
            COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:v2_test_q8_finite_scale_contract_${_fp32_subnormal_isa_lower}>
                --gtest_filter=CPUExplicitRoundingContract.Q8FiniteScaleCompiledISAPath:CPUExplicitRoundingContract.DeviceFP32SubnormalFixedWords
            LABELS "V2;Integration;CPU;${_fp32_subnormal_isa};NumericalContract;ByteExact;Regression"
            MPI_PROCS 1 NO_MODELS NO_MPI TIMEOUT 30)
        list(APPEND V2_FP32_SUBNORMAL_PREFLIGHT_TESTS
            V2_Integration_FP32SubnormalContract_CPU_${_fp32_subnormal_isa})
    endif()
endforeach()

add_v2_test(V2_Integration_CPUExplicitRoundingContract
    COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:v2_test_cpu_explicit_rounding_contract>
    LABELS "V2;Integration;ProductionTestPreflight;CPU;Numerics;MoE;AllFormats;ByteExact;Regression"
    NO_MODELS NO_MPI MPI_PROCS 1)

# =============================================================================
# E2E Parity Tests
# =============================================================================
# Full pipeline and kernel parity tests comparing different execution paths
# Organized by: what is being tested vs what reference
#
# Structure:
#   e2e/parity/pytorch/       - Against PyTorch ground truth
#   e2e/parity/internal/      - Llaminar modes compared against each other
#   e2e/parity/kernels/       - Individual kernel comparisons

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Integration Parity: MPI Tensor-Parallel vs Single-Rank
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# MPIPipeline_vs_SingleRank removed — superseded by per-backend LocalTP/LocalPP/HybridPPTP parity tests

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# DISABLED: E2E Parity tests moved to Integration or deprecated
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# NOTE: FP32Pipeline_vs_PyTorch was removed - superseded by 
# integration/parity/qwen2/Test__Qwen2_CPU_vs_PyTorch.cpp which uses
# the standardized ParityTestBase infrastructure.
find_package(ZLIB)
if(ZLIB_FOUND)
    get_filename_component(WORKSPACE_ROOT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../.." ABSOLUTE)
    
    if(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE MATCHES "Debug" OR CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE MATCHES "Integration" OR ENABLE_SNAPSHOTS)
    else()
        message(STATUS "V2: Integration parity tests disabled (snapshots not available in Release build)")
        message(STATUS "     Use -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Integration or -DENABLE_SNAPSHOTS=ON to enable")
    endif()
else()
    message(WARNING "ZLIB not found - PyTorch parity tests disabled (requires cnpy for .npz loading)")
endif()

# =============================================================================
# GPU Device Context Integration Tests
# =============================================================================
# Tests GPUDeviceContextPool and IGPUDeviceContext implementations for both
# CUDA (NvidiaDeviceContext) and ROCm (AMDDeviceContext). Validates:
# - Memory allocation/deallocation through contexts
# - Host-to-device and device-to-host transfers
# - Event creation, recording, and synchronization
# - Concurrent access from multiple threads
# - Multi-device scenarios

if(HAVE_CUDA OR HAVE_ROCM)
    add_executable(v2_integration_gpu_device_context
        integration/backends/Test__GPUDeviceContextIntegration.cpp
    )
    if(LLAMINAR_SHARED_CORE)
        target_link_libraries(v2_integration_gpu_device_context PRIVATE
            llaminar2_core
            GTest::gtest
            GTest::gtest_main
        )
    elseif(UNIX AND NOT APPLE)
        # Must include cuda_backend/rocm_backend with --whole-archive to ensure static
        # initializers (factory registrars) are included even if not directly referenced.
        # Without --whole-archive, the linker won't include AMDContextFactory.cpp.o or
        # NvidiaContextFactory.cu.o since they only contain static initializers.
        set(_gpu_backends_whole "")
        if(HAVE_CUDA)
            list(APPEND _gpu_backends_whole -Wl,--whole-archive cuda_backend -Wl,--no-whole-archive)
        endif()
        if(HAVE_ROCM)
            list(APPEND _gpu_backends_whole -Wl,--whole-archive rocm_backend -Wl,--no-whole-archive)
        endif()
        target_link_libraries(v2_integration_gpu_device_context PRIVATE
            -Wl,--start-group
            llaminar2_core
            ${_gpu_backends_whole}
            -Wl,--end-group
            GTest::gtest
            GTest::gtest_main
        )
    else()
        target_link_libraries(v2_integration_gpu_device_context PRIVATE
            llaminar2_core
            GTest::gtest
            GTest::gtest_main
        )
    endif()
    add_v2_test(V2_Integration_GPUDeviceContextIntegration
        COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:v2_integration_gpu_device_context>
        LABELS "V2;Integration;Backend;GPUDeviceContext;CUDA;ROCm;Threading;WorkerThread;Memory;Events"
        MPI_PROCS 1
    )
    message(STATUS "V2 Tests: Added GPU Device Context Integration tests")
endif()

    # the existing maximum for model-free production preflight entries; the
    # canonical six-device host completes this full suite in about 34 seconds.

# Startup observation lifecycle on production kernels; no real model admission.
# One observer owns device 0: launching duplicate non-MPI gtest processes would
# contaminate native graph-pool deltas with allocations from the other process.
add_executable(v2_integration_planning_execution_measurement
    integration/planning/Test__PlanningExecutionMeasurement.cpp
    integration/planning/Test__PlanningProjectionMeasurement.cpp
    integration/planning/Test__PlanningLocalTPMeasurement.cpp
    integration/planning/Test__PlanningCPUExpertMeasurement.cpp
    integration/planning/Test__PlanningGPUExpertMeasurement.cpp)
target_link_libraries(v2_integration_planning_execution_measurement
    llaminar2_core GTest::gtest_main)
foreach(measurement_backend IN ITEMS CPU CUDA ROCm)
    if(measurement_backend STREQUAL "CUDA" AND NOT HAVE_CUDA)
        continue()
    endif()
    if(measurement_backend STREQUAL "ROCm" AND NOT HAVE_ROCM)
        continue()
    endif()
    add_v2_test(V2_Integration_PlanningExecutionMeasurement_${measurement_backend}
        COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:v2_integration_planning_execution_measurement>
            --gtest_filter=PlanningExecutionMeasurementIntegration.${measurement_backend}:PlanningExecutionMeasurementIntegration.${measurement_backend}_SourceSamples:PlanningExecutionMeasurementIntegration.${measurement_backend}_PreparedExpert*:PlanningExecutionMeasurementIntegration.${measurement_backend}_FloatingPreparedAccounting:PlanningExecutionMeasurementIntegration.${measurement_backend}_Projection*
        LABELS "V2;Integration;Planning;${measurement_backend};Regression"
        MPI_PROCS 1 TIMEOUT 120 NO_MODELS)
    # The standard launcher binds one socket and exposes that socket's physical
    # core budget. CPU evidence therefore uses discovery's socket-local MPI
    # ownership, not the single-rank whole-host inventory. GPU ordinal 0 must
    # retain exactly one reporter.
    set(streaming_measurement_ranks 1)
    if(measurement_backend STREQUAL "CPU")
        set(streaming_measurement_ranks 2)
    endif()
    add_v2_test(V2_Integration_PlanningStreamingBandwidth_${measurement_backend}
        COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:v2_integration_planning_mpi_transfers>
            --gtest_filter=PlanningExecutionMeasurementIntegration.${measurement_backend}_StreamingBandwidth
        LABELS "V2;Integration;Planning;${measurement_backend};Regression;ProductionTestPreflight"
        MPI_PROCS ${streaming_measurement_ranks} TIMEOUT 60 NO_MODELS)
    if(NOT measurement_backend STREQUAL "CPU")
        add_v2_test(V2_Integration_PlanningHostDeviceService_${measurement_backend}
            COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:v2_integration_planning_mpi_transfers>
                --gtest_filter=PlanningExecutionMeasurementIntegration.${measurement_backend}_HostDeviceService
            LABELS "V2;Integration;Planning;${measurement_backend};Regression;ProductionTestPreflight"
            MPI_PROCS 1 TIMEOUT 60 NO_MODELS)
        add_v2_test(V2_Integration_PlanningNativeLocalTP_${measurement_backend}
            COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:v2_integration_planning_execution_measurement>
                --gtest_filter=PlanningExecutionMeasurementIntegration.${measurement_backend}_NativeLocalTP
            LABELS "V2;Integration;Planning;${measurement_backend};Regression;ProductionTestPreflight"
            MPI_PROCS 1 TIMEOUT 60 NO_MODELS)
        add_v2_test(V2_Integration_GPUPreparedWeightBinding_${measurement_backend}
            COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:v2_integration_planning_execution_measurement>
                --gtest_filter=PlanningExecutionMeasurementIntegration.${measurement_backend}_CoalescedPool

            TIMEOUT 120 NO_MODELS)
    endif()

    if(HAVE_ROCM)

            LABELS "V2;Integration;ProductionTestPreflight;${_lifetime_labels};TensorParallel;MTP;WeightLifecycle;Regression"
            MPI_PROCS 1 NO_MODELS TIMEOUT 120)

    if(HAVE_ROCM)

    endif()

                    COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:v2_integration_moe_pipeline_weight_preparation>

                    MPI_PROCS 1 NO_MODELS TIMEOUT 120

# Complete inter-vendor generation preserves native TP within each layer domain.

    add_executable(v2_integration_pipeline_domain_generation
        integration/execution/runner/Test__PipelineDomainGeneration.cpp)
    target_link_libraries(v2_integration_pipeline_domain_generation PRIVATE llaminar2_core GTest::gtest GTest::gtest_main)
    foreach(_order CUDA_ROCm ROCm_CUDA)
        string(REPLACE "_" ";" _backends "${_order}")
        list(GET _backends 0 _first)
        list(GET _backends 1 _last)
        foreach(_width 1 2 4)
            set(_pipeline_hardware_skip "")
            if(_width EQUAL 4)
                set(_pipeline_hardware_skip SKIP_REGULAR_EXPRESSION "Requires 4 CUDA and ROCm devices")
            endif()
            foreach(_lane Ordinary FixedMTP DynamicMTP)
                math(EXPR _total_devices "2 * ${_width}")
                set(_case "${_first}${_width}_${_last}${_width}_${_lane}")
                foreach(_resident_suffix "" "_Admitted128")
                    add_v2_test(V2_Integration_PipelineDomainGeneration_${_case}${_resident_suffix}
                        COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:v2_integration_pipeline_domain_generation>
                            --gtest_filter=CrossBackend/PipelineDomainGeneration.ExactCapturedRequestsAndContinuation/${_case}${_resident_suffix}
                        LABELS "V2;Integration;ProductionTestPreflight;Pipeline;GraphCapture;CUDA;ROCm;MTP;Devices${_total_devices};Regression"
                        MPI_PROCS 1 NO_MODELS TIMEOUT 120 ${_pipeline_hardware_skip})
                endforeach()
            endforeach()
        endforeach()
    endforeach()
endif()
