# =============================================================================
# Python Reference Module Tests (PyTorch parity infrastructure)
# =============================================================================
# The python/reference/ package provides the PyTorch reference implementation
# used by C++ parity tests. Pytest auto-discovers all test_*.py files under
# python/reference/tests/, so new pure-unit test files are picked up
# automatically without editing this CMakeLists.txt.
#
# Only fast unit tests run here (no GGUF model loading, ~15s total).
# Integration tests (model loading, inference) are excluded via --ignore
# for pure-integration files and -k filters for mixed files.
#
# Python3 is already found by the parent CMakeLists.txt (src/v2/CMakeLists.txt).

set(PYTHON_REFERENCE_ROOT "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/../..")

if(NOT V2_PERF_TESTS_ONLY)
# Auto-discovers every test_*.py in python/reference/tests/ EXCEPT:
#   --ignore: pure-integration files (all classes load GGUF models)
#   -k:       integration classes in mixed files (GGUFLoading, Inference, etc.)
add_test(
    NAME V2_Unit_Python_Reference_All
    COMMAND ${Python3_EXECUTABLE} -m pytest
        python/reference/tests/
        --ignore=python/reference/tests/test_gguf_parser.py
        --ignore=python/reference/tests/test_gguf_inference.py
        -v --tb=short
        -k "not (GGUFLoading or Inference or GGUFCompatLoading or GGUFDimensionOrder or DequantizationVsLlamaCpp)"
)
set_tests_properties(V2_Unit_Python_Reference_All PROPERTIES
    LABELS "V2;Unit;Python;Reference;Dequantize;GGUFParser;Qwen35;MoE;GatedDeltaNet"
    WORKING_DIRECTORY "${PYTHON_REFERENCE_ROOT}"
    TIMEOUT 900
    # These tiny reference tensors need one physical worker. Parent and child
    # imports otherwise create independent BLAS/OpenMP pools across the host,
    # overrunning this fixture's reservation during the unrestricted Unit gate.
    ENVIRONMENT "OMP_NUM_THREADS=1;OMP_DYNAMIC=false;OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1;MKL_NUM_THREADS=1;MKL_DYNAMIC=false;NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS=1;BLIS_NUM_THREADS=1;VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS=1;LLAMINAR_FORCE_CPU_ONLY_STARTUP=1"
)
foreach(V2_CPU_BUDGET_TEST IN ITEMS V2_Unit_UnitCpuBudget V2_Integration_UnitCpuBudget)
    add_test(NAME ${V2_CPU_BUDGET_TEST}
        COMMAND ${Python3_EXECUTABLE} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/unit/scripts/test_unit_cpu_budget.py
            --build-dir ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}
            --sweep-threads ${V2_CPU_GEMM_PARITY_MAX_THREADS}
            --logical-per-core ${V2_TEST_THREADS_PER_CORE})
    set_tests_properties(${V2_CPU_BUDGET_TEST} PROPERTIES
        LABELS "V2;BuildSystem;CPU;Ownership;Regression;DeviceFree"
        TIMEOUT 30)
endforeach()
set_property(TEST V2_Unit_UnitCpuBudget APPEND PROPERTY LABELS Unit)
set_property(TEST V2_Integration_UnitCpuBudget APPEND PROPERTY LABELS "Integration;ProductionTestPreflight")
# The same reference-only generator used by every MoE backend is an admission
# dependency of numerical parity. Exercise publication, identity, and equation
# failures here without any real model or accelerator allocation.
add_v2_test(V2_Integration_ParityRouteConditionedHFReference
    COMMAND ${Python3_EXECUTABLE} -m pytest
        python/reference/tests/test_moe_route_conditioned_reference.py -q --tb=short
    LABELS "V2;Integration;Parity;Reference;MoE;Numerical"
    MPI_PROCS 1
    NO_MODELS
)
endif()

# The label, not the list above, is the installed gate's inventory authority.
# Apply its admission invariants to every labeled test so a focused regression
# registered near its fixture cannot silently bypass metadata validation.
get_property(V2_REGISTERED_PREFLIGHT_CANDIDATES DIRECTORY PROPERTY TESTS)
foreach(V2_PREFLIGHT_TEST IN LISTS V2_REGISTERED_PREFLIGHT_CANDIDATES)
    get_property(V2_PREFLIGHT_LABELS
        TEST ${V2_PREFLIGHT_TEST} PROPERTY LABELS)
    if("${V2_PREFLIGHT_LABELS}" MATCHES "ProductionTestPreflight")
        # Preflight is deliberately model-free. Reject a registration that
        # forgot add_v2_test(... NO_MODELS) while CMake still owns the typed
        # fixture metadata, rather than discovering it during a campaign.
        get_property(V2_PREFLIGHT_FIXTURES
            TEST ${V2_PREFLIGHT_TEST} PROPERTY FIXTURES_REQUIRED)
        if(V2_PREFLIGHT_FIXTURES)
            message(FATAL_ERROR
                "Production test preflight test requires a fixture: "
                "${V2_PREFLIGHT_TEST} (${V2_PREFLIGHT_FIXTURES})")
        endif()
        get_property(V2_PREFLIGHT_HAS_TIMEOUT
            TEST ${V2_PREFLIGHT_TEST} PROPERTY TIMEOUT SET)
        if(NOT V2_PREFLIGHT_HAS_TIMEOUT)
            set_tests_properties(${V2_PREFLIGHT_TEST} PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 120)
        endif()
    endif()
endforeach()
endif()

# CTest's unrestricted parallel level is expressed in logical CPUs, whereas
# unit-test worker budgets above are deliberately expressed in physical cores.
# Normalize every configured Unit test in one final pass, including direct
# add_test() registrations and explicit heavyweight overrides. This keeps the
# wrapper, raw Python tests, and nested-worker trainers under one accounting
# authority instead of relying on per-test timeout luck on SMT hosts.
get_property(V2_CONFIGURED_TESTS DIRECTORY PROPERTY TESTS)
foreach(V2_CONFIGURED_TEST IN LISTS V2_CONFIGURED_TESTS)
    get_property(V2_CONFIGURED_TEST_LABELS
        TEST ${V2_CONFIGURED_TEST} PROPERTY LABELS)
    if("${V2_CONFIGURED_TEST_LABELS}" MATCHES "Unit")
        get_property(V2_TEST_HAS_PROCESSORS
            TEST ${V2_CONFIGURED_TEST} PROPERTY PROCESSORS SET)
        if(V2_TEST_HAS_PROCESSORS)
            get_property(V2_TEST_PHYSICAL_PROCESSORS
                TEST ${V2_CONFIGURED_TEST} PROPERTY PROCESSORS)
        else()
            set(V2_TEST_PHYSICAL_PROCESSORS 1)
        endif()
        math(EXPR V2_TEST_LOGICAL_PROCESSORS
             "${V2_TEST_PHYSICAL_PROCESSORS} * ${V2_TEST_THREADS_PER_CORE}")
        set_tests_properties(${V2_CONFIGURED_TEST} PROPERTIES
            PROCESSORS ${V2_TEST_LOGICAL_PROCESSORS})
    endif()
endforeach()

# Build authority for the complete registered unit suite.  Script-only tests
# correctly add no dependency and execute in the subsequent CTest phase.
# Dependencies are collected by add_v2_test(), where CMake still has the exact
# target behind each registration; this avoids a hand-maintained mirror of the
# 500+ executable inventory.
if(NOT V2_PERF_TESTS_ONLY)
    get_property(V2_UNIT_GATE_TARGETS GLOBAL PROPERTY V2_UNIT_GATE_TARGETS)
    list(REMOVE_DUPLICATES V2_UNIT_GATE_TARGETS)
    if(NOT V2_UNIT_GATE_TARGETS)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "The V2 unit gate has no executable targets")
    endif()
    add_custom_target(v2_unit_gate DEPENDS ${V2_UNIT_GATE_TARGETS})

    # Use the final CTest label inventory, not a second hook-owned executable
    # list. Shared fixtures are built once; only the labeled tests are run.
    set(V2_PREFLIGHT_GATE_TARGETS "")
    foreach(V2_CONFIGURED_TEST IN LISTS V2_CONFIGURED_TESTS)
        get_property(V2_CONFIGURED_TEST_LABELS
            TEST ${V2_CONFIGURED_TEST} PROPERTY LABELS)
        if("ProductionTestPreflight" IN_LIST V2_CONFIGURED_TEST_LABELS)
            get_property(V2_TEST_BUILD_TARGETS GLOBAL PROPERTY
                "V2_TEST_BUILD_TARGETS_${V2_CONFIGURED_TEST}")
            list(APPEND V2_PREFLIGHT_GATE_TARGETS ${V2_TEST_BUILD_TARGETS})
        endif()
    endforeach()
    list(REMOVE_DUPLICATES V2_PREFLIGHT_GATE_TARGETS)
    if(NOT V2_PREFLIGHT_GATE_TARGETS)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "The production preflight gate has no executable targets")
    endif()
    add_custom_target(v2_production_test_preflight_gate
        DEPENDS ${V2_PREFLIGHT_GATE_TARGETS})
endif()

    COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:v2_test_workspace_memory_estimator>
        --gtest_filter=Test__WorkspaceMemoryEstimator.ROCmRoutedParticipantQuantizedWorkspaceIsCodebookIndependent:Test__WorkspaceMemoryEstimator.Qwen122ROCmTP4Depth15CoversExactQuantizedGemmFamily
    LABELS "V2;Integration;ProductionTestPreflight;DeviceFree;ROCm;FP16;Workspace;Regression"
    MPI_PROCS 1 NO_MODELS TIMEOUT 30)

       (V2_HC103_PERF_BACKEND STREQUAL "ROCm" AND HAVE_ROCM))

            COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:v2_perf_q8_residual_prepared_projection>

            ENVIRONMENT ${V2_HC103_PERF_ENV}

    endif()
